title: Open Mic @ Hub Cafe
event_description: Musicians singers comedians and poets gather every first and third Thursday for an intimate open mic night. Equipment sponsored by Roots Music with rotating menu of small bites and pizza. Sessions end with a large jam.
event_venue_information:
About Hub Cafe

Hub Cafe is a farmer-owned cafe that opened in 2016 at the scenic Jayne Snyder Trails Center in Lincoln's Telegraph District. The venue is rooted in community connections and sources sustainable foods from local growers and small farms in Lincoln and the surrounding area.

Open Mic Nights

The Hub Cafe hosts open mic nights on the first and third Thursday of each month from 5-8pm with equipment setup sponsored by Roots Music. The events welcome musicians singers comedians and poets and always end with a large jam session. Chefs Jake and Kelley provide a rotating monthly menu of pizza and small bites to enjoy during performances.

Other Events

The venue also hosts Hub and Soul - a free community event featuring music local food and Lincoln's parks held on select dates throughout the summer months at nearby Union Plaza Amphitheatre. Friday nights feature live local music and creative pizzas making it a popular weekend destination in the Telegraph District.

The Space

Located at the Jayne Snyder Trails Center the Hub Cafe offers a welcoming atmosphere with views overlooking the beautiful Antelope Valley. The venue is walkable bikeable and has car parking available making it easily accessible from downtown Lincoln.

title: Jazz Jam @ Zoo Bar
event_description: Lincoln's longest running weekly jazz jam session hosted by The Jazzocracy. Open to students and jazz musicians to jam or for anyone to listen. Features a wide variety of modern and classic jazz compositions. No cover charge.
hosts: The Jazzocracy - Bill Wimmer Aaron Stroessner Brian Gerkensmeyer Parker Sibley
event_venue_information:
About Zoo Bar

The Zoo Bar is a legendary blues music venue and nightclub located in downtown Lincoln on 136 North 14th Street. Styled around the Chicago blues clubs it is a long narrow venue in a building built in 1921. The Zoo has been a staple for live music in downtown Lincoln since 1973.

The Jazzocracy Jazz Jam

Every Tuesday night at 6pm the Zoo Bar hosts The Jazzocracy - Lincoln's longest running weekly jazz jam session. The event is open to students and jazz musicians who want to come jam or for anyone who wants to come listen. The sessions feature a wide variety of modern and classic jazz compositions with no cover charge. Among the hosts are Bill Wimmer on saxophone Aaron Stroessner on guitar Brian Gerkensmeyer on bass and Parker Sibley on drums. The night continues with DJ Relic spinning soul music till morning.

Other Weekly Events

Mondays feature Emily Bass and friends playing up close and personal next to the bar taking requests from 5:30 to 7:30pm. The first Sunday of each month hosts an afternoon jam session from 2-5pm where solo performers and group performances are welcome with accompaniment available. Thursdays feature Shithook Live Band Karaoke where the audience picks songs and the band plays them live.

History and Recognition

In 1993 the Zoo Bar won the Blues Foundation's Keeping the Blues Alive Award for Club of the Year. Over the years legends like Buddy Guy Bo Diddley Albert Collins Robert Cray Magic Slim Koko Taylor and many more have graced its stage. The bar celebrated its 51st anniversary in 2024 and continues to be one of the most important blues venues in the Midwest.

title: Open Mic @ Night Owl Pub
event_description: Weekly open mic night welcomes all genres of musicians and performers. A music family atmosphere that creates a gathering space for local musicians singer-songwriters and music lovers. Sign up through Facebook event page.
backline: PA Sound Engineer DI boxes Mics and occasional sharing of drum kits
event_venue_information:
About Night Owl Pub

Night Owl Pub is a neighborhood pub-style bar located in south Lincoln offering a spot for people who want to escape the crowd and try new drinks including martinis mules mojitos and house-made infusions. The venue has a safe atmosphere for all ages over 21 and hosts weekly open mic nights.

Open Mic Night

Every Wednesday from 8pm to 1am Night Owl Pub hosts Lincoln Open Mic Night. The event is hosted by Jackie Storm and welcomes music lovers of all types. The venue provides PA system sound engineer DI boxes microphones and occasionally allows sharing of drum kits and other instruments. All genres are welcome making it an inclusive space for diverse musical expression.

Sign Up Process

To sign up performers go to the Lincoln Open Mic Night Facebook page and find the event for the date they would like to play. Under Discussion on the event page is the sign up sheet where performers can comment to request a time slot. The sheet is updated continuously as people sign up.

Community Focus

The event operates with a mission to hold a creative space for the gathering growth and enjoyment of local musicians and singer-songwriters as well as Lincoln Nebraska's own live music scene. It's described as a music family that welcomes music lovers of all types with open arms to come and enjoy as well as participate.

title: Open Mic @ Bourbon Theatre
event_description: Weekly open mic night open to all facets of music. 18+ age requirement. Special time slots set aside for featured local and touring acts. Housed in a completely remodeled 1920s movie theatre.
event_venue_information:
About Bourbon Theatre

The Bourbon Theatre is located inside a completely remodeled 1920 movie theatre and has emerged as a premier music venue in Nebraska's capital city. Since opening in 2009 it has undergone numerous renovations and upgrades to become one of the most sought-after clubs in the Midwest.

Open Mic Night

Every Monday at 8pm the Bourbon Theatre hosts open mic night which continues until close. The event is open to all facets of music and has an 18+ age requirement. Special time slots are set aside for featured local and touring acts making it a platform for both emerging and established artists.

The Venue

Originally a turn-of-the-century movie theater the Bourbon has the ability to host events large and small making it a unique and intimate space to see a show. The venue features a bar stocked with a wide variety of whiskeys tended by experienced bartenders. Situated in downtown Lincoln just a few blocks from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln it is a pillar in the bustling strip of bars restaurants retail and entertainment on O Street.

Diverse Programming

Whether fans enjoy rock country rap blues or anything in between the Bourbon Theatre offers a diverse calendar of events. Recent and upcoming performances have included bands across many genres making it a cornerstone of Lincoln's music scene. The vintage marquee at 1415 O Street announces upcoming acts and has become an iconic landmark in downtown Lincoln.
